property_summary: After any successful Put by any actor for any amount, every subsequent nonReentrant entry point (Collect) must execute without reverting (it may simply no-op if its conditions fail); the mutant never releases the reentrancy lock, so Collect reverts after any Put.
change_summary: Delete the trailing `locked_ = false;` in the nonReentrant_ modifier so the lock is never released after Put completes, causing all subsequent guarded calls to revert.
